I can see the bug clearly now. In `if_network_partition`, `new->interface_names` is **not initialized** (unlike `address_string`, `uc_addresses`, etc. which are set to NULL). So `interface_names` contains garbage.

Then in `convert_network_partition_interfaces`:
```c
char *copy = ddsrt_strdup (np->interface_names), *cursor = copy, *tok;
```
This calls `ddsrt_strdup` on an uninitialized pointer, which will likely crash or read garbage. And in `convert_network_partition_addresses_one`:
```c
else if (strspn (np->interface_names, ", \t") != strlen (np->interface_names))
```
This also reads the uninitialized pointer.

The description says "invalid free operation". Let me check how the config is freed - `free_configured_element`:
